method: RoboStats PowerScale: TrueSkill core (μ 25, σ 8.33, β 10, τ 1, draws 2%); quals 1×, elim win 2× / loss 0.25×, finals win 3× / loss 0.25×, Signature events ×1, score margin (typical 36 pts = 1×, cap 2×); σ +5 at each new event, fading to 80% per event. Teams start from 50% of last season's rating. Ranked on match play alone: μ − 3σ + ln(1 + matches/20) + elim bonus ln(1 + elim points: champion 1, finalist 0.5, semifinalist 0.25, ×1.5 at Signature events). Predictions use the same formula plus skills from earlier events (driver + half programming, by rank, on the ratings' own scale: new teams start there, teams move 20% toward it at each new event, carried-over teams 25% at their first), which predicts better.
